# Trademark policy

"ServerOS", the ServerOS logo and the ServerOS Cloud name are trademarks of ServerOS Cloud Ltd. The [AGPL](../LICENSE) gives you rights to the code. It doesn't give you rights to our name or logo.

We want people to talk about, write about and build things for ServerOS. We also need people to know what's really ours, so nobody gets confused about who they're trusting with their servers.

## Fine without asking

- Saying your product works with, integrates with or is built for ServerOS.
- Writing articles, tutorials and videos about ServerOS.
- Running the unmodified panel and calling it ServerOS.
- Using the name in a fork's README to say where it came from, for example "a fork of the ServerOS panel".

## Not fine without written permission

- Calling a fork, a modified build or a hosted service "ServerOS", or a name that's easy to mix up with it.
- Using the ServerOS logo in your product, site or app icon.
- Suggesting that ServerOS Cloud Ltd made, endorses or supports your product when it doesn't.
- Using "ServerOS" in a company name, product name or domain name.

## If you fork the panel

Pick a new name, take out the ServerOS logo and other brand assets, and don't point your users at ServerOS support. You don't need to remove copyright notices or license files. The AGPL says you must keep those.

## Asking

Not sure, or want permission for something above? Email [liam@serveros.com](mailto:liam@serveros.com).
